{{Top|leg}}
The '''YZ series''' was a series of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].

The CEC denied that the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the YZ series were originally intended to be converted to be combat vessels and sold to paramilitary organizations, despite them being used regularly for just that purpose.<ref name="Message to Spacers 3: YZ-775 Transport">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/Mesop3|text=Message to Spacers 3}}</ref>
